summary: Single-JSON snapshot save (autosave.json et al) written atomically with .bak rollback, plus side-channel persistence: per-chunk JSON files in a per-save chunks dir, and three SQLite DBs (faction.db, world_memory.db, content_registry.db) that live in the save dir and are authoritative for their systems (the JSON only stores metadata blobs for them). Top-level shape: version, save_timestamp, player, world_state, quest_state, npc_state, game_settings, [dungeon_state], [map_state], faction_state, content_registry_state (save_manager.py:56-125). Load recreates the world from the saved seed, builds a fresh Character, then restores player→invented recipes→world→quests→NPCs→factions→game_time→dungeon→map in that order (game_engine.py:2081-2160). Active quests are serialized but silently DROPPED on load; only completed-quest ids survive. WMS/Faction/ContentRegistry are Python-side SQLite systems a Godot port can stub (their restore paths are already no-ops/metadata-only).
player_facing: Autosave to autosave.json on window-close quit unless temporary world; prints '💾 Autosaved on quit' + WMS saved (game_engine.py:613-632)
ESC from start menu also autosaves before exiting (game_engine.py:688-704)
Pause menu: 0=Return, 1=Save & Exit → autosave.json (save failure still exits), 2=Exit without saving (game_engine.py:2007-2044)
F6 = manual quicksave to save_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json, notification 'Saved!' (game_engine.py:1186-1203)
F9 = in-session load autosave.json; Shift+F9 = load default_save.json; resets camera, notification (game_engine.py:1231-1277)
Start menu: option 1 'Load World' loads autosave.json with loading screen + seed-based world rebuild; option 2 loads default_save.json same flow (game_engine.py:2078-2248)
No load → keeps menu open, notification 'No save file found! Create a new world or use Temporary World.' (game_engine.py:2164-2167)
Corrupt primary save silently falls back to .bak: 'Recovered from backup save (one save older than latest).' (save_manager.py:550-562)
Crash → best-effort emergency save to crash_recovery.json, never overwrites autosave (game_engine.py:12013-12035)
Save-file browser metadata: filename, timestamps, version, character level, sorted newest-first (save_manager.py:667-715)
Temporary worlds never save (guard on every save path) (game_engine.py:615, 1188, 2016)
No periodic/timed autosave exists — saves are event-driven only (all save_game call sites: game_engine.py:616,691,1191,2018,12023)
mechanics: TOP-LEVEL SAVE DICT: version, save_timestamp (ISO now), player, world_state, quest_state, npc_state, game_settings, optional dungeon_state/map_state, faction_state, content_registry_state (save_manager.py:56-125)
ATOMIC WRITE: json.dumps fully in memory first (serialization error can't truncate), write to <file>.tmp with flush+fsync, os.replace old→.bak, os.replace tmp→file (save_manager.py:503-518)
LOAD + .bak FALLBACK: missing file → None; JSONDecodeError/UnicodeDecodeError on primary → read <file>.bak; no backup → None (save_manager.py:541-562)
VERSION: SAVE_VERSION='3.0'; missing version defaults to '1.0'; mismatch prints warning only, load proceeds (save_manager.py:19,564-567)
GAME SETTINGS: only Config.KEEP_INVENTORY saved/restored (save_manager.py:127-137,589-599)

PLAYER BLOCK: position{x,y,z}, facing, stats{strength,defense,vitality,luck,agility,intelligence}, leveling{level,current_exp,unallocated_stat_points}, health/max_health/mana/max_mana, class (class_id or null), inventory, equipment, equipped_skills (list of 5, nullable), known_skills{id:{level,experience}}, titles [title_id], activities{name:count}, stat_tracker dict, skill_unlocks{unlocked_skills,pending_unlocks}, invented_recipes (save_manager.py:139-198)

INVENTORY SLOT: null OR {item_id, quantity, max_stack, rarity, [equipment_data], [crafted_stats dict]}; equipment_data = {item_id,name,tier,rarity,slot,damage (tuple→list),defense,durability_current,durability_max,attack_speed,efficiency,weight,range,hand_type,item_type,icon_path,soulbound} + conditional stat_multipliers/tags/effect_tags/effect_params/bonuses/enchantments/requirements (only written when truthy) (save_manager.py:239-310)

EQUIPMENT: dict keyed by slot name → null or same full equipment_data shape as inventory (preserves per-item durability + enchantments) (save_manager.py:312-371); 10 slots: mainHand,offHand,helmet,chestplate,leggings,boots,gauntlets,accessory,axe,pickaxe (equipment_manager.py:10-21)

INVENTED RECIPE RECORD: {timestamp, discipline, item_id, item_name, item_data, from_cache, recipe_inputs, station_tier, narrative, placement_data, icon_path}; per-recipe try/except so one bad recipe doesn't kill the save (save_manager.py:200-237)

WORLD_STATE: seed, game_time, placed_entities, crafting_stations, discovered_dungeons, spawn_chest, death_chests; get_save_state also flushes every loaded modified chunk to its chunk file first (world_system.py:1442-1462); SaveManager overwrites game_time with engine's value (save_manager.py:392-397)

PLACED ENTITY: position{x,y,z}, item_id, entity_type (enum NAME string), tier, health, owner, time_remaining, tags, effect_params, + range/damage/attack_speed only for turret-likes (world_system.py:1464-1491); restore defaults tier=1, health=100.0, time_remaining=300.0 and rebuilds barrier tile cache (world_system.py:1536-1571)
CRAFTING STATION: position + station_type (enum NAME) + tier; on load, saved list REPLACES defaults only if non-empty (world_system.py:1493-1502,1590-1606)
DISCOVERED DUNGEONS: [{chunk_x, chunk_y, position, rarity(enum value)}] keyed back to (cx,cy); updates already-loaded chunk's entrance (world_system.py:1504-1514,1573-1588)

CHESTS: LootChest.to_dict = {chest_id, position, tier, is_opened, contents (list of [id,qty] pairs), is_player_storage, is_death_chest, [rich_contents only when death chest]}; from_dict re-tuples contents (dungeon.py:367-397); missing spawn_chest → spawn fresh one (backwards compat) (world_system.py:1608-1624)

CHUNK FILES: per-save dir saves/<savename>_chunks/chunk_{x}_{y}.json (world_system.py:1020-1028,912-927); saved only when has_modifications() (modified resources OR dungeon entrance OR template lock) (chunk.py:625-629); content = {chunk_x, chunk_y, chunk_type, template_locked, [modified_resources], [dungeon_entrance], [unload_timestamp]} (chunk.py:631-667)
RESOURCE MOD RECORD: {local_x, local_y, resource_type, current_hp, max_hp, depleted, time_until_respawn} keyed 'x,y' local to chunk (chunk.py:591-610)

CHUNK LOAD: template_locked defaults True for legacy files (never re-roll explored chunks); locked chunk_type overrides procedural roll; elapsed = game_time - unload_timestamp added to respawn timers, auto-respawns resource if timer exceeded (world_system.py:966-1014; chunk.py:669-708)
CHUNK LIFECYCLE: chunks auto-save on unload (prepare_for_unload records timestamp + marks damaged resources) and auto-load from file before procedural generation (world_system.py:893-910,431)

QUEST_STATE: completed_quests list + active_quests{id:{status,progress,baseline_combat_kills,baseline_inventory}} (save_manager.py:399-423); restore keeps ONLY completed list — active quests intentionally skipped ('Quest database not implemented') (quest_system.py:564-595)
NPC_STATE: {npc_id: {current_dialogue_index}}; restore sets index per matching npc, default 0 (save_manager.py:425-459)

DUNGEON_STATE: {in_dungeon, current_dungeon, dungeons_completed, dungeons_by_rarity}; DungeonInstance = {dungeon_id, rarity, current_wave, total_waves, wave_enemies_remaining, total_enemies_killed, awaiting_next_wave, is_cleared, is_active, entrance_time, chest, return_position, spawned_enemy_ids} (dungeon.py:586-635,785-805; save_manager.py:603-640); if loaded in_dungeon → spawn_dungeon_wave, else spawn_initial_enemies count=5 (game_engine.py:2142-2153)

MAP_STATE: {explored_chunks[], waypoints[] (nullable slots), last_teleport_time, map_zoom, map_scroll_x/y, stats}; spawn waypoint always re-initialized from config regardless of save (map_waypoint_system.py:648-700)

STAT_TRACKER (playtime lives here): to_dict = {version:'2.0', session_start_time, total_playtime_seconds, session_count, stats (categorized SQL dump), legacy gathering_totals/combat_damage/combat_kills/crafting_by_discipline dicts, unique_chunks_visited} (stat_tracker.py:806-844); from_dict accepts v2.0 and v1.0, re-tuples chunk coords (stat_tracker.py:919-939); playtime accumulated via update_playtime(dt) (stat_tracker.py:76-78); session end flushed on quit (game_engine.py:633-642)

LOAD ORDER (start-menu path — the canonical one): 1) load_game reads JSON + restores game settings; 2) rebuild WorldSystem from world_state.seed under loading screen; 3) set_chunk_save_directory('<savefile>'); 4) fresh Character at spawn; 5) character.restore_from_save(player); 6) register_saved_invented_recipes; 7) world.restore_from_save; 8) quests.restore_from_save; 9) restore_npc_state; 10) restore_faction_state; 11) game_time from world_state; 12) restore_dungeon_state; 13) map_state; 14) enemy spawns + combat_manager.character rebind + character.dungeon_manager/world_system refs; 15) _init_world_memory re-init (game_engine.py:2081-2160)

CHARACTER RESTORE INTERNAL ORDER (matters): position/facing → stats → leveling → class (set_class) → recalculate_stats → health/mana AFTER recalc → inventory (fresh None slots, rebuild ItemStacks + EquipmentItem, damage list→tuple) → equipment (dict format; legacy string item_id fallback via EquipmentDatabase) → known_skills via learn_skill(skip_checks=True) then overwrite level/exp → equipped_skills re-equipped into 5 slots → titles by id (unknown ids dropped) → activities → stat_tracker from_dict (or fresh+start_session) → skill_unlocks (or fresh system) → FINAL recalculate_stats → invented recipes appended + registered with RecipeDatabase as 'invented_<item_id>' (character.py:365-638,640-694)

INVENTED RECIPE RE-REGISTRATION: engine-level pass registers each with the discipline Crafter, RecipeDatabase and PlacementDatabase so instant-craft, recipe list and placement grid all work; gridSize from placement_data else '3x3' (game_engine.py:6204-6273)
LEGACY (pre-seed) SAVES: no seed → fresh random-seed world + Chunk.restore_water_chunks(world_state.water_chunks) (game_engine.py:2097-2107; chunk.py:54)
SAVE-FILE ENUMERATION: every *.json in save dir; reads save_timestamp/version/player.leveling.level for menu display; ignores .bak/.tmp by extension filter (save_manager.py:667-715)
data: saves/ dir: source-run → <root>/Game-1-modular/saves; PyInstaller bundle → %APPDATA%/Game1/saves (Win), ~/Library/Application Support/Game1 (mac), ~/.local/share/Game1 (Linux) (core/paths.py:38-76)

Save files: autosave.json (default), default_save.json (shipped template, generated by save_system/create_default_save.py), save_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>.json (F6), crash_recovery.json (emergency), plus .bak and transient .tmp siblings (save_manager.py:461-525; game_engine.py:1196,12028)
Chunk sidecar files: saves/autosave_chunks/chunk_{cx}_{cy}.json or saves/default_save_chunks/... ; fallback saves/chunks/ when no dir set (world_system.py:922-927,1026-1027)

SQLite in save dir (Python-only, stub in Godot): faction.db (paths.py:122-129), world_memory.db via WMS init with save_path (game_engine.py:5097-5102), content_registry.db flushed at save time (save_manager.py:89-100)
faction_state blob is metadata only: {version, db_path, initialized}; load() is a no-op — SQLite file is authoritative (faction_system.py:635-645)
content_registry_state blob: {db_path, stats} or {initialized:false} or {} — informational only (save_manager.py:97-123)

Example player fields: class:'warrior'|null; equipped_skills:[null×5]; titles:['novice_miner']; inventory slot: {item_id:'iron_sword', quantity:1, max_stack:1, rarity:'fine', equipment_data:{...durability_current:87...}, crafted_stats:{...}} (save_manager.py:150-308)
Enum-string encodings in world_state: entity_type/station_type use Python enum NAME (e.g. 'BARRIER'), dungeon rarity uses enum VALUE (e.g. 'common') (world_system.py:1475,1499,1511)
constants: SAVE_VERSION = '3.0' (v3: infinite world, seed-based) ; absent version defaults to '1.0'; mismatch = warning only (save_manager.py:19,565-567)
Inventory 30 slots (inventory.py:110); ItemStack defaults max_stack=99, rarity='common'; equipment forced max_stack=1 (inventory.py:14,16,31)
Equipment slot key set of 10 incl. tool slots axe/pickaxe (equipment_manager.py:10-21)
Load defaults: durability 100/100, attack_speed 1.0, efficiency 1.0, weight 1.0, range 1.0, hand_type 'default', item_type 'weapon', damage [0,0], slot 'mainHand' (character.py:434-459)
Placed-entity load defaults: tier=1, health=100.0, time_remaining=300.0 (world_system.py:1551-1554)
Chunk file name f'chunk_{cx}_{cy}.json'; chunk dir f'{savename-minus-ext}_chunks' (world_system.py:927,1026-1027)
template_locked defaults True for legacy chunk files (never re-roll seen chunks) (world_system.py:973; chunk.py:644-648)
Post-load enemy spawn count=5; training dummy at (10.0, 0.0) (game_engine.py:2153-2157)
Invented recipe id format f'invented_{item_id}'; default gridSize '3x3' (character.py:662-665)
hazards: ACTIVE QUESTS ARE LOST ON LOAD by design-gap: serializer writes status/progress/baselines but restore prints 'Quest database not implemented' and only keeps completed_quests — preserve this exact behavior or consciously fix it (save_manager.py:409-423; quest_system.py:578-595)

CHUNK-DIR MISMATCH BUG: 'New World' never calls set_chunk_save_directory, so a fresh world writes chunk files to default saves/chunks/; after quit+Load World the dir becomes saves/autosave_chunks/ — first-session chunk modifications are orphaned (grep: only game_engine.py:2096,2187 set it; fallback world_system.py:922-927)

F9 IN-SESSION LOAD does NOT rebuild the world from the saved seed nor reset the chunk dir — it restores state onto the CURRENT WorldSystem; loading a save from a different-seed world via F9 desyncs terrain vs. saved entities (game_engine.py:1244-1276 vs. 2087-2096)
Chunk sidecar files are NOT atomic-written (plain open+dump, no tmp/fsync/.bak) — only the main JSON gets the atomic protocol (world_system.py:941-945)

Chunk files are written as a SIDE EFFECT of get_save_state() (i.e., during create_save_data), before the main JSON write — a failed main save can still have flushed newer chunk files (world_system.py:1448-1451)
Load with corrupt primary + valid .bak restores an OLDER state but chunk files/SQLite DBs stay at NEWEST — cross-store version skew is accepted (save_manager.py:550-562)

Conditional keys: equipment stat_multipliers/tags/effect_tags/effect_params/bonuses/enchantments/requirements and chunk modified_resources/dungeon_entrance are OMITTED when falsy — port must treat absence as empty, not error (save_manager.py:276-302; chunk.py:651-662)
damage is tuple in Python, list in JSON; restore re-tuples via isinstance check — duck-typing trap (save_manager.py:262,327; character.py:433-436)

health/mana restored BETWEEN the two recalculate_stats calls; final recalc after equipment can change max_health while current health keeps the saved value (no clamp shown) — replicate order exactly (character.py:406-411,594-595)

Order dependence: class must be set before first recalc; skills use learn_skill(skip_checks=True) then overwrite level/exp; invented-recipe registration happens twice (inside character restore → RecipeDatabase, then engine pass → Crafters+PlacementDatabase) (character.py:398-407,542-556,601-636; game_engine.py:6204+)
restore_from_save on WorldSystem replaces crafting stations only when saved list is non-empty — empty list keeps procedural defaults (world_system.py:1590-1593)
ItemStack.__post_init__ consults Material/Equipment DBs and can override saved max_stack and auto-create equipment_data — DB content silently wins over saved values (inventory.py:19-34)
Spawn waypoint is force-reset from config on every load, overriding saved coords (map_waypoint_system.py:685-688)
Enum encoding is inconsistent: NAME for entity/station types, VALUE for dungeon rarity — mismatching these breaks lookup (world_system.py:1475,1499,1511,1545,1582)

Every restore layer is wrapped in try/except with print-and-continue (faction, dungeon, invented recipes, content registry) — a Godot port should degrade the same way, not hard-fail (save_manager.py:74-124,631-640,655-665; character.py:606-632)

PYTHON-ONLY / STUBBABLE: WMS (world_memory.db, save() on quit game_engine.py:629-631, re-init after load game_engine.py:2160), FactionSystem (SQLite authoritative, JSON blob decorative, load no-op faction_system.py:643-645), ContentRegistry flush (save_manager.py:89-124), StatTracker's SQL StatStore backing (to_dict/from_dict already produce a plain dict — port can keep dict only, stat_tracker.py:806-939), graceful_degrade logger (save_manager.py:109-122)
get_save_files reads every .json in the dir with no schema guard — non-save JSON in the folder just logs an error per file (save_manager.py:680-710)
delete_save_file removes only the .json, leaving .bak + chunk dir + SQLite orphans (save_manager.py:717-740)
Emergency save deliberately uses a distinct filename so possibly-corrupt state never clobbers autosave.json — preserve this separation (game_engine.py:12013-12035)
